description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various news sources, divided into 17 categories. The chart includes slices labeled with news source names, such as Breitbart (blue, 14%), Other (gray, 13%), Drudge Report (orange, 8%), and The Daily Caller (green, 8%). Other notable slices include The Huffington Post (red, 7%), NPR (purple, 6%), Vox (brown, 6%), The Guardian (pink, 5%), and BBC (tan, 4%). The remaining slices, including RT, Daily Kos, National Review, Daily Mail, Red State, Fox News, CNN, PoliticusUSA, and Shareblue, each account for approximately 3% of the total. The chart includes numerical labels inside each slice, indicating the percentage or proportion, and the slices are arranged in a seemingly unordered manner. No legend is present, and none of the slices are visually emphasized.
